security_audit.summary: All 30 external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown inline-code formatting in SKILL.md; no shell or Ruby execution is present. A separate high-severity concern instructs agents to rewrite sensitive wording after a safety rejection and retry, which could facilitate provider safety-filter evasion.

remediation.issue: The safety-rejection guidance can encourage evasion by removing sensitive wording and retrying.
remediation.suggestion: Do not retry rejected content through euphemistic rewriting. Stop, explain the rejection, and only offer a clearly compliant alternative that preserves safety intent.

content.user_title: Generate Clear Spoken Audio from Scripts
content.value_statement: Voice selection and speech preparation can make text-to-speech inconsistent. This skill selects models and voices, prepares pronunciation, tunes delivery, and splits long scripts.
actual_capabilities: Selects expressive, multilingual, or fast speech models based on script length, performance needs, and cost sensitivity.
Filters available voices by gender, accent, age, language, use case, and search terms.
Prepares scripts by removing unspoken text and spelling numbers, dates, currency, acronyms, and URLs for pronunciation.
Tunes speech delivery with speed, stability, style, and similarity settings.
Splits long scripts at natural production boundaries and batches up to ten clips per request.
Diagnoses common issues such as drift, mispronunciation, unstable delivery, and partial batch failures.
limitations: Generates speech only; it does not create music, sound effects, ambience, dubbing, or voice clones.
Does not mix speech with other tracks or place audio on a video timeline.
Requires an available provider, a compatible model, and a valid voice identifier.
Audio quality and supported languages depend on the selected provider, model, and voice.

use_cases.title: Produce Marketing Voiceovers
use_cases.description: Turn approved campaign copy into consistent ad reads with selected voices and controlled delivery.

use_cases.title: Create Long-Form Narration
use_cases.description: Prepare and split explainers, documentaries, or audiobook sections while preserving voice and model consistency.

use_cases.title: Generate Character Dialogue
use_cases.description: Create separate spoken lines for characters with stable voice assignments across multiple clips.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Voiceover
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate spoken audio from this approved script. Offer three suitable voice previews before creating the final clip: [script].
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a short voiceover with guided voice selection.

prompt_templates.title: Timed Advertisement
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this script for a [duration]-second advertisement. Preserve every claim, spell symbols naturally, and use an energetic but clear delivery: [script].
prompt_templates.scenario: Fit approved promotional copy to a target duration.

prompt_templates.title: Multilingual Narration
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate narration in [language] from this approved script. Choose a compatible voice and model, then split only at natural section breaks: [script].

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Character Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Create separate audio clips for each line in this dialogue. Assign one approved voice per character and keep model and delivery settings consistent: [dialogue].
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate production-ready dialogue across several characters and scenes.

output_examples.input: Create a warm fifteen-second voiceover from an approved product announcement.
output_examples.output: Three warm voice previews are presented for selection. After approval, one labeled audio file contains the prepared fifteen-second announcement.

output_examples.input: Narrate a long training script with stable delivery.
output: The script is divided at section boundaries.
Each clip uses the same narration voice and model.
The returned audio files are labeled by training section.

output_examples.input: Generate dialogue for two characters across four scenes.
output_examples.output: Each character keeps one selected voice across separately labeled scene clips, with consistent delivery settings.

best_practices: Approve the exact spoken script before generating audio.
Preview two or three matching voices and confirm the selection with the user.
Write text as it should sound, then split only at real production boundaries.
anti_patterns: Do not infer voice attributes from display names.
Do not use speed controls to force an oversized script into a short duration.
Do not substitute another tool when the requested work requires music, mixing, dubbing, or cloning.

faq.question: Can this skill create music or sound effects?
faq.answer: No. It creates spoken audio only and does not generate music, effects, or ambience.

faq.question: Can it mix narration with background music?
faq.answer: No. It returns clean speech files for assembly in an audio or video editor.

faq.question: How does it choose a voice?
faq.answer: It filters available voices by requested attributes and presents suitable previews unless the user already supplied a voice identifier.

faq.question: How are long scripts handled?
faq.answer: The skill checks model limits and splits scripts at natural section or scene boundaries when needed.

faq.question: Can it generate non-English speech?
faq.answer: Yes, when the selected model and voice support the requested language.

faq.question: What happens when audio generation fails?
faq.answer: The skill retries limited transient failures, preserves successful batch items, and reports provider or configuration errors.
